vad_provenance.purpose: Offline native speech activity detection before Uzbek decoding; no automatic downloading.

Baseline and first two turbo tests briefly overlapped; their timings are indicative and do not support a speed-ratio claim. Final candidate was sequential.
Synthetic non-speech controls and one noisy human stress probe are not real microphone/room/accents testing.
On one human clip with additive white noise at15dBSNR the final WER remained85.7%, CER48.6%; VAD removes non-speech hallucination in these probes but cannot repair all noisy speech.
